records.subject: AMER_ST
records.title: Introduction to American Cultural Studies
records.description: Introduction to the interdisciplinary study of American cultures and the field of American studies. (Crosslisted course offered as AMER ST 216, CES 216, ENGLISH 216, HISTORY 216, WGSS 216.)

records.subject: AMER_ST
records.title: Racial Justice Movements
records.description: Examines racial justice movements since the 1960s, exploring the lessons, tactics, histories, and significance of movements across multiple communities.  (Crosslisted course offered as AMER ST 264, CES 264.  Formerly offered as AMER ST 474, CES 464.)

records.subject: AMER_ST
records.title: Race, Popular Culture, and Post-Civil Rights America
records.description: An examination of sports, television, film, music, and other examples of popular culture as resistance.  (Crosslisted course offered as AMER ST 471, CES 461.)

records.subject: AMER_ST
records.title: Race, Justice, and Food Ecosystems
records.description: Examines racial inequalities and injustice alongside of movements of change, highlighting the importance of food in a modern world.  (Crosslisted course offered as AMER ST 472, CES 462, ENGLISH 472.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: AMER_ST
records.title: Art as Resistance
records.description: Highlights artists and movements often erased within dominant narratives about art, and within galleries and museums.  (Crosslisted course offered as AMER ST 473, CES 463.)
